failures.question: How much is the bounce fee when a UPI AutoPay mandate fails due to insufficient balance?
failures.actual:
The bounce fee for a UPI AutoPay mandate failure due to insufficient balance is ₹500 plus 18% GST per bounce occurrence [1][3][5].

Note: ₹500 is stated in the FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual, not in the FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP; it may not apply to that product.

answers.question: What processing fee is charged on a FinBase personal loan?
answers.answer:
The processing fee charged on a FinBase personal loan is 1.5% of the gross sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹1,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000. Additionally, Goods and Services Tax (GST) at 18% is applicable over and above the processing fee and is deducted upfront from the disbursed proceeds [1][2][3][4].

Note: This applies to all retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03, and any deviation requires approval from the Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager [4].

Additionally, you will need a blank white sheet of paper and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. You also need a high-speed internet connection, an active smartphone or laptop camera and microphone, and device geolocation (GPS) enabled to verify your physical presence within India during the video session [4][5].
